entry.title: Anthropic’s Mega-IPO Plan Looms Over Packed US Listing Calendar
entry.summary: Anthropic PBC’s IPO is casting a long shadow over companies’ US listing plans, as they try to find room for their deals to grab attention after the Sept. 7 Labor Day holiday. The Claude developer is preparing to file publicly for an initial public offering that’s expected to raise as much as SpaceX’s record $86.2 billion debut, if not more, in the coming weeks. entry.title: Aliko Dangote's Daughters Join Succession Plan
entry.summary: As Aliko Dangote prepares for Africa's largest IPO, he is breaking tradition by bringing his three daughters into the group's succession plan. Mariya, Halima, and Fatima have spent more than ten years working quietly behind the scenes of their father's multi-billion dollar conglomerate, which spans industries from cement and sugar to fertilizer and refined crude. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: U.S. court rules Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic was unlawful
entry.summary: A federal court in San Francisco has ruled that the Pentagon unlawfully classified Anthropic as a supply chain risk. The Department of Defense blacklisted the company in retaliation for its public criticism of government AI policy.
